ValidationRule.description: QCC: Don't change Recovery Status back to Open
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Donot_change_Recovery_Status__c = True, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', Text(Status__c)='Open', Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))<>'Rejected', Text(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))<>'Open')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can't be changed to Open
